projects.name: ML Enhanced Dynamic MAC Protocol Optimization
projects.description: A continuous-time, physics-aware Discrete-Event Simulation framework that models MAC-layer protocols and uses a Random Forest classifier to dynamically optimize protocol selection in real-time.

projects.name: IMC Prosperity Trading Bot
projects.description: A robust algorithmic trading bot developed for the IMC Prosperity challenge. Features safe mid-price handling, dynamic execution thresholds, and queue-priority logic to execute profitable trades.

projects.name: ML Framework for AQI Classification
projects.description: An applied machine learning framework leveraging XGBoost to classify the Air Quality Index (AQI) of the Delhi NCR region, achieving 98% accuracy through temporal data harmonization.

projects.name: 2D Game Engine in Java
projects.description: A custom 2D game engine built from scratch in Java, featuring a complete Entity Component System (ECS), batch rendering with OpenGL, an integrated Dear ImGui editor with docking, JBox2D physics, and GSON-based scene serialization.

projects.name: Waffle Da! — Brand Website & App
projects.description: Production domain website and companion mobile app for the Waffle Da! brand. A customer-facing ordering site with a dynamic multi-category menu, gourmet item customization, real-time order tracking, and a Supabase-backed admin dashboard for live inventory and order management.
